$Comment: Bram the Shepherd's Christmas shop: snowballs, a free bundle once a day and more for a couple of
Christmas Coins, which Currencies puts in the header, and his Yeti Bait. Season makes the shop, and
every offer naming it, absent while Christmas is off. Players reach it through Bram: his Christmas
conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Shepherd.json) and, while Harvest Feast's last days
still run, the Christmas line added to his feast conversation (DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/
Christmas_Shepherd_Feast_Line.json). It carries no Where, so it opens wherever he stands. Order 93
keeps it behind a server's everyday storefronts. It includes no festival shelf: Christmas's is at
Santa's shop (Christmas_Santa.json). The shop's name and its category's are keys in
